sceneDescription: Inside a hyper-realistic, well-lit warehouse resembling a high-tech fulfillment center, an absurdly oversized, sparkling gemstone—larger than a refrigerator—rides majestically along an industrial conveyor belt. Surrounding it, normal-sized gold jewelry items are being sorted by robotic arms, while a few tiny delivery drones buzz around, attempting (and obviously failing) to lift the giant gem. In the background, a group of workers wearing safety vests gaze in disbelief at the spectacle. The gemstone’s facets reflect the utilitarian warehouse lighting, creating a surreal contrast between high luxury and gritty logistics. Everything looks plausible, except for the out-of-place, comically massive jewel dominating the scene.
